messages.text: hey mei, still up? i'm prepping the deck skeleton and i need to know exactly which screenshots you want for slide 3. the 'zoom out' moment?

barely 😴 yes! i want the specific pair you two (or whatever dummy data) have, showing the tooltip first, then a transition to the full atlas. can you get that sequence recorded as a short gif or just high-res stills? i'll animate it in the deck if needed

stills are safer for the projector. i can do a 3-second screen capture of the hover state -> zoom out. give me 10 mins to pick the best pair that doesn't look like 'i like pizza' + 'i also like pizza'

lmao yes, avoid the pizza cliché. maybe something with 'distributed systems' and 'raft consensus'? since we know that one works well in the backend? or just a random interesting overlap like 'synesthesia' and 'color theory'?
i checked the db. 'synesthesia' connects to 'perception' which is super rare in our sample. that's a good high-idf match. i'll use that for the hero shot. it looks visually distinct on the atlas too.
perfect. that feels more 'smart' and less 'generic'. okay, slide 4 is where you explain the rarity weighting? i think we need a visual for that. do we have one yet?

not really. i can generate a simple bar chart showing how 'python' is weighted low vs 'graph neural networks' weighted high. i'll style it with the turquoise tokens so it doesn't look like an excel screenshot.

yes please. keep it minimal though. we have 5 minutes for the whole demo, remember? i'm aiming for 1 minute intro, 2 minutes live app, 1 minute 'why it matters', 1 min q&a buffer. you have to be fast with the mouse movements

i'll pre-load the specific user profile so there's no search delay. i'll also have the 'why' explanation pre-rendered in my head so i don't stumble. is it okay if i just click and talk over the animation?

totally fine. just make sure you don't click the settings toggle by accident! i'll be standing right next to you with a 'do not touch' hand ready. good luck with the screenshots, send them when you're done so i can place them before bed
